Frequency Once per day

You know how to ritualistically entertain the living and the dead in a way that honors them, enrapturing them. You Perform in such a way that grabs the attention of undead within 60 feet of you, regardless of your proficiency in Performance and if they were mindless. On a successful performance, in addition to their potential effects as normal for Perform, creatures paying attention to you become Fascinated and Stunned 1. On a critical success, they become Fascinated and Stunned 2 instead. Once they have been the target of this feat, they are immune to Dance on the Graves for 24 hours. This action gains the Auditory, Visual or even Linguistic trait depending on the nature of your performance.
